nodes.title: Halt token / :halted
nodes.body: Halt token / :halted — the marking a slice deposits when it exhausts its rework/retry budget without going green; the slice stops, the net keeps running elsewhere.

detail.definition: the marking a slice deposits when it exhausts its rework/retry budget without going green; the slice stops, the net keeps running elsewhere.

nodes.title: Seeded contradiction
nodes.body: Seeded contradiction — an intentionally unsatisfiable slice spec (transform-b’s two mutually-exclusive criteria) used to cause a halt on purpose. A fixture device, not a bug.

nodes.title: Unreachable join

nodes.title: Grounding exchange (ported interview)
nodes.body:
Q: Sketch resilient-pipeline in one breath: what is it, and what does the seeded halt demonstrate?

A: A CSV parse→transform→serialize pipeline where transform-b is intentionally contradictory and halts, isolating failure while the serialize join stays provably unreachable.

nodes.title: Design answer (ported interview)
nodes.body: Isolate failure to the halted slice’s downstream cone; keep the serialize join waiting (unreachable), not failed.
